subject: Citywide Bike Plan and Safety Ordinance
overview: The commission reviewed ongoing infrastructure updates for Salem Street and the Clippership Connector while discussing the framework for a new citywide bike plan. Members also began brainstorming the components of a potential cycling safety ordinance with input from a visiting city councilor.

items.title: Call to Order and Roll Call
items.summary: The chair called the meeting to order and the secretary noted the resignation of commissioner Lisa Duraco.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission approved the minutes from the previous meeting.

items.title: Announcements and Event Recaps
items.summary: Members discussed the success of the Circle the Square event and the need for more volunteer presence at public tabling events.

items.title: Expanding Light Distribution to Seniors and Disabled Residents
items.summary: Commissioners discussed repurposing bike lights as safety lights for wheelchair users and collaborating with the Medford Housing Authority and the Commission for Persons with Disabilities.

items.title: Bike Light Kit Funding and Sponsorships
items.summary: The commission approved one new order of bike light kits and discussed seeking corporate sponsors to offset the costs of mass distribution in the fall.

items.title: Bike Infrastructure and Rack Updates
items.summary: The transportation engineer reported that new bike rack installations are currently on hold while the department prioritizes Green Line Extension and Bluebikes connectivity.

items.title: Salem Street Redesign Review
items.summary: The commission reviewed updated plans for the eastern end of Salem Street, focusing on the configuration of bike lanes near bus stops and the Fellsway intersection.

items.title: Project Updates: Clippership Connector and GLX Lanes
items.summary: Staff reported that DCR is finalizing the Clippership Connector design and that resurfacing is required on George Street before new bike lane striping can occur.

items.title: Citywide Bike Plan Development
items.summary: The transportation department's new intern introduced the framework for the citywide bike plan, formerly known as the master plan, including goals for public engagement and data collection.

items.title: Data Sources for Bicycling Routes
items.summary: Members debated the utility of Strava and Streetlight data for identifying popular commuting routes while noting the demographic skews inherent in crowdsourced fitness apps.

items.title: Complete Streets and Cycling Safety Ordinance
items.summary: City Councilor Kit Collins joined a discussion on drafting a cycling safety ordinance to institutionalize infrastructure improvements during road repaving projects.

items.title: Ordinance Components and Implementation
items.summary: The commission brainstormed safety requirements for city vehicles, police training, and utility coordination to ensure bike facilities are consistently improved during street work.
